subject: Recurrence vs truth; mechanics vs claims vs heuristics
statement: Repetition shows that a belief or practice recurs, not that it is true. Frequency is not importance. Synthesis must keep mechanics, claims, heuristics and advice distinct.
verbatim:
Repeated source claims establish repeated practitioner belief or pedagogy.

Repeated actions establish repeated practitioner practice.

Neither establishes universal correctness.

verbatim: **Reconciled principle:** covered-call premium is not “yield plus unchanged equity participation.” It is compensation received while surrendering some upside participation. Premium income and forgone upside are both decision-relevant economic consequences.

subject: Construction ≠ purpose
statement: A strategy name says which contracts exist, not why the trade exists. Purpose such as income, disposition, acquisition, protection or leverage can change while the construction vocabulary stays the same.
verbatim: The name of the construction tells us what contracts exist. It does not tell us why the trader should own them.
